name: Ambient Liquid
description: Curl-advected liquid with a REAL Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system: U and V concentrations carried in dataTextureA, a five-tap Laplacian from exact textureLoad fetches, and feed/kill rates driven per FFT band so different frequencies push the system between spot, stripe and mitosis regimes. The V concentration raises local surface tension and pulls the metaball isosurface inward. Fixes a shader that advertised reaction-diffusion while its grayScott() was four sine waves with no state at all.

updatedParams.name: Flow Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Curl displacement scale; higher damps the flow (zoom_params.x).

updatedParams.name: Turbulence
updatedParams.description: Noise frequency of the curl and FBM fields (zoom_params.y).

updatedParams.name: Ripple / Feed
updatedParams.description: Click ripple strength; also biases the Gray-Scott feed rate (zoom_params.z).

updatedParams.name: Hue / Kill
updatedParams.description: Hue rotation; also biases the Gray-Scott kill rate (zoom_params.w).
